finalModelMessage:
Registration did not complete. The meal preference control is not exposed in the accessibility tree, so I could not select a meal.

**What stopped me**

I reached `/inaccessible`, opened **Building Accessible Forms in Java** (via `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms` after Register was not a button/link), filled **Jordan Lee**, first submitted **jordan-not-an-email**, then corrected to **jordan.lee@example.com**, and checked terms via the unlabeled checkbox.

I could not finish registration because **Meal preference** is only static text (`Meal preference…`). It is not a combobox, listbox, select, button, textbox, or labeled field, so no meal could be chosen. Submit after a valid email and checked terms did nothing and showed no confirmation code or error.
